id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_044.pack|cs_:
"I am Psaroid, guardian of the fourth
  Adventure Log, granted the power
  of Psaro the Manslayer...

"The fifth Log was mine. I am Nimclops,
  granted the power of Nimzo, demon king
  of kings!

"Heh heh. And I, Mortamammoth, ruined
  the sixth Adventure Log with
  the power of Mortamor!

"We saw the whole process of how you
  restored the Logs we twisted.

"As expected of a hero, but you're no
  match for us guardians, granted
  the great Lord's power.

"Come, worm! We'll show you the might of
  the great god who made us
  and your own imperfection!

"I don't know the god's intent...
  But I know what I must do.

"Gwaaargh!!
  I'll root out all who
  try to pass this point!!
